rows.ToIn (converts only to In): takes the me:
constexpr Out o{ToIn{}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 7 && o.in.b == 8 && o.z == 5);
rows.Both (to In and to int): takes the membe:
constexpr Out o{Both{}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 7 && o.in.b == 8 && o.z == 5);
rows.Both (to In and to int): braces elided:
constexpr Out o{Both{}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 1 && o.in.b == 5 && o.z == 0);
rows.Any (template): takes the member whole:
constexpr Out o{Any{}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 7 && o.in.b == 8 && o.z == 5);
rows.Any (template): braces elided:
constexpr Out o{Any{}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 1 && o.in.b == 5 && o.z == 0);
rows.Any, Any: takes the member whole:
constexpr Out o{Any{}, Any{}};
static_assert(o.in.a == 7 && o.z == 1);
rows.DIn (derived from In): takes the member:
constexpr Out o{DIn{{7, 8}}, 5};
static_assert(o.in.a == 7 && o.in.b == 8 && o.z == 5);
rows.control: int values fill the member by e:
constexpr Out o{1, 2, 3};
static_assert(o.in.a == 1 && o.in.b == 2 && o.z == 3);
